text:
kevin: Heads up — staging docs build failed during linkcheck. Multiple broken image relpaths in /guides/migration and a stray HTML comment that breaks MDX rendering.

ci-bot: Linkcheck found 12 404s in guides/migration — see log: https://ci.redwood/in/1234 (job 78)

anna_docs: Oof. I think this came in with the 2026-content-migration branch. I saw some image paths that start with './assets//' (double slash) and a few that use backslashes from Windows.

miguel: Quick grep shows a few files with non-ASCII zero-width spaces (ZWSP) in filenames — those became invisible during the move. I'll open a cleanup PR to normalize names.

anna_docs: Also noticed an MDX admonition rendering as raw HTML. The top of guides/migration/overview.mdx has a stray comment: `<!--markdown-->` which Docusaurus treats oddly. Removing it fixes the admonition.

kevin: Can we patch linkcheck instead of skipping it? Skipping hides regressions and we should keep strictness for newly migrated pages.

miguel: Opening PR now: #4578 — it normalizes paths (collapses duplicate slashes), strips ZWSPs, and replaces backslashes with forward slashes. Will use `git mv` where possible to preserve history.

ryan_se: If we use `git mv` make sure we update any relative paths in code samples too. +1 on not skipping linkcheck.

anna_docs: PR includes a tiny helper script and tests. Example usage:```
python scripts/normalize_paths.py --dir docs/guides/migration
```It fixes ./assets//img.png -> ./assets/img.png and renames files to remove ZWSPs.

lisa: Can we add a short whitelist for legacy external redirects? Some legacy URLs 301 and trip linkcheck. But agree we should keep strict checks for new content.

linkcheck-bot: Re-run requested by miguel — linkcheck status: in progress (runner 9).

ci-bot: Deploy preview available at https://deploy.previews.redwood/rc/3265 — preview should show fixed images and MDX render.

anna_docs: :eyes: Preview looks good for me. Images load and the admonition renders correctly. Miguel's PR fixes the double-slash and the ZWSP rename.

miguel: Merging PR #4578 now. Will keep an eye on post-merge linkcheck run.

linkcheck-bot: All checks passed on main after merge — 0 broken links in /guides/migration. :tada:

kevin: Thanks everyone. Follow-up: I'll add a short note in CONTRIBUTING.md about avoiding ZWSPs and ensuring Unix-style relpaths when moving files.

lisa: Thanks for handling this quickly. Saves a nasty surprise during the next release cut.
